description: Flight Computer audio integration manifest derived from the supplied Cutlass audio package. Binary OGG assets are intentionally not included; place the supplied OGG files at the listed resource paths before packaging.

takeoff.reason: Primary integrated takeoff recording; replaces the previous takeoff/flight base audio path.
takeoff.direction: Play when stabiliser/autopilot control becomes active, cross-fade to the integrated flight loop at 22 seconds, then stop the takeoff layer.

flight_loop.direction: Use as the main continuous flight layer after the 22 second takeoff handoff; do not retain the old continuous engine loop beneath it.

ghost_2.reason: Additional ambient flight layer requested to remain active during stabiliser or autopilot control.
ghost_2.direction: Play alongside the primary flight audio whenever either stabiliser OR autopilot is active; fade out when neither control mode is active.

engine_secondary_effects.reason: Secondary effects/reactions from the supplied manifest.
engine_secondary_effects.direction: Layer only when the corresponding flight condition occurs; never use as the continuous base flight loop.

cockpit_ui.reason: Short cockpit/UI feedback effects with restrained volume.
cockpit_ui.direction: Remain independent of continuous flight ambience.

attenuation.reason: Preserve the established practical Flight Computer ambient radius.
